messages:
jenna: Quick FYI for the 01:00-03:00 UTC window. Deploybot will run sequenced pins. Planned order this time: api -> router -> runtime -> console (small infra tweak on router). Versions: api@1.16.0 router@3.11.0 runtime@2.7.0 console@4.4.0. @marco can you confirm router graceful drain and runtime warmup?

deploybot: Deploybot: preflight passed at 00:45 UTC. Will apply pins with 5s spacing and emit step events. Canary support enabled per service.

marco: Router plan: graceful connection drain for 45s before pin. I'll coordinate drain at T-5m and watch upstream 502s. Runtime warmup handled by irene.

irene: Runtime warmup: prime KV prefixes session/* and ctx/*, call /ops/warmup on all active shards, then a 6% canary for 6m. Starting warmup at 00:54.

oncall_todd: Rollback criteria we expect: sustained error rate >0.45% for 5m OR p95 latency +500ms. Unpin perms: I have them. Preferred staged unpin: stop router then runtime then api to shrink blast radius.

jenna: Note: console has a non-blocking flag for display changes (FF-console-ui-2041) that we can flip instantly. Adding runbook links to the release note.

deploybot: Starting pin sequence: api pinned -> router pending -> runtime queued -> console queued. Event ref: deploy_1755_x.

irene: Warmup logs: /ops/warmup returned 200 on all 5 shards. KV priming OK, no eviction spikes. Canary shift to runtime at +2m.

marco: Beginning router drain at -3m, connections draining, health checks still green. Will start pin after drain complete.

oncall_todd: If I need to unpin quickly, commands below. I'll mute noisy alerts and open incident ticket on action.

```
# staged unpin sequence (router then runtime then api)
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"router","version":"3.11.0"}'
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"runtime","version":"2.7.0"}'
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"api","version":"1.16.0"}'
```

jenna: Canary +4m: runtime error rate 0.04%, p95 +20ms. Router drain showed no 502 surge.

deploybot: router pinned -> runtime pending -> console queued. Event: deploy_1755_y.

oncall_todd: I'll be on pager for next 40m. If metrics cross threshold I'll run staged unpin and post timestamps here.

irene: Canary +6m: stable. Monitoring dashboards and posting snapshots to the watch channel.

jenna: Thanks everyone. Final step: console pin after we confirm post-pin smoke. Release notes updated with pin order and unpin snippets. :white_check_mark:
